newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares rise on trade figures.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares rise on trade figures.

text.p: Danish share prices rose on Monday, boosted by better-than-forecast February export figures, dealers said.
At 0840 GMT the KFX top-20 index was up 0.49 point from Friday's close, to stand at 160.09.
Its June future rose 0.55 point, to 160.35.

Dealers feared that the weak dollar could dampen potential gains. They expected trade to focus on banking, still seen as a good buy relative to bank shares in other countries and the object of foreign buying interest --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom + 45-33-969650
